title: Preserve persistence body failures across lock context managers
description: P3 robustness review: AnnounceStatePersistence._lock and TwoSlotFilePersistence._process_lock catch OSError around the contextmanager yield, so disk/fsync/write failures from the protected operation are mislabeled as lock failures and their public error semantics change. Isolate lock acquisition/setup exception handling from the yielded body and add injected body-OSError coverage for both modules.
